title: Kerala Lottery Result, October 2, 2025: No Draw Today Due To Dussehra, Gandhi Jayanti Holiday | India News - News18
text: Kerala Lottery Result Today Live, 02-10-2025: No Kerala lottery draw will be held today due to the public holiday on account of Gandhi Jayanti and Dussehra. The Kerala State Lottery Department will hold the next draw on Thursday, 3 October 2025, for the Suvarna Keralam SK-21 lottery. Following that, the much-awaited Thiruvonam Bumper BR-105 draw will take place on Friday, 4 October 2025. Stay tuned for the latest updates, results, and prize details as soon as they are announced. ALSO READ: Happy Dussehra 2025: Top 50 Wishes, Images, Quotes And Status To Share With Your Loved Ones On Vijayadashami Winners are required to verify their ticket numbers by cross-checking them with the official results published in the Kerala Government Gazette. After confirmation, they must visit the Kerala Lottery Office at Gorky Bhavan, near Bakery Junction, Thiruvananthapuram, to claim their prize. The official winning numbers are available on the Kerala Lottery website: keralalottery.info. For convenience, the results can be downloaded in PDF format from the website for future reference. Winners are required to submit their original winning ticket within 30 days of the draw date. Failing to do so will result in the forfeiture of the prize. The ticket, along with the necessary documents, must be submitted to the designated authority based on the prize amount, as outlined below: All prize claims must be submitted within 30 days of the draw date, accompanied by the original ticket and the necessary supporting documents.
